NOTE
**Close — competes with open PRs #38098 and #39481 for the same issue, with no explanation of why this one is needed**

New: The author squashed to one commit, filled in the checklist, and fixed multi-line text handling, but did not run the new test locally. Missing: any explanation of how this PR relates to #38098 and #39481, which are both open and already pinged for maintainer review.

###### Next step

Close it as a duplicate of the PRs already in review, since squashing commits doesn't answer the competing-PR problem: `gh pr close 39820 --repo zulip/zulip`

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the PR! We're closing it because #38098 and #39481 are already in review for the same issue, and there's no explanation of how this one differs (see our [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html)).
```
